body: The observed manual-ingest and auto-ingest overlap was a test-induced edge case. Raw queued-row count and immediately claimable rows may differ under that overlap, but no day-to-day concurrency or reporting fix is currently required. Do not promote this observation into a canonical Known Gap or degraded maintenance outcome.
creator: operator
rationale: The user explicitly concluded there was nothing to fix after identifying that a manual ingestion was started while automatic ingestion was already running.
title: Raw ingest count is not an active product gap
